create_IRFunctionsMode: create an IRFunctionsMode instance with folder, languages, and bpe to process source code into IR format
extract_data_for_line: extract standalone functions and their IR representations from a JSON line of source code content
check_files_and_symlink_for_XLM: check dataset files exist and create symlinks in XLM-syml folder for parallel dataset training
tokenize_and_convert_to_IR: tokenize source code content, extract functions, and convert each function to intermediate representation
filter_IR_errors: filter out functions that had errors during IR conversion and log the error rate
